output.summary: A and B are both excellent and factually accurate; A is slightly more concise and brand-tailored, while B adds deeper denominator arithmetic. C is accurate and well-prioritized but a bit less actionable. D has strong arithmetic but is generic, omits a concrete holdout/brand-specific next steps, and does not use TrailFold product/stock facts.
